crop.description: Normalized rectangle after turns, flips, perspective and straightening; runtime also checks x+width and y+height <=1 with float boundary tolerance.

red.description: Custom PCHIP requires points in [0,1] with strictly increasing x and nondecreasing y; endpoints may move along x and y and the curve clamps flat outside [x0, x_{n-1}]. These relational rules are validated by the core.
